description: Automation rules for Document Manager and Document Organizer. Controls when skills fire automatically, what scope they cover, and whether human approval is required.

pre_commit.description: Runs on every commit when staged .md files are detected. Blocks commits with missing timestamps or Purpose lines.

post_merge.description: Runs after git merge or rebase completes. Reconciles God file with any path changes.

post_organizer.description: Runs after the Organizer completes a live move. Reconciles manifest, updates paths, rewrites links.

nightly_cron.description: Nightly drift detection. Catches stale files, orphan candidates, missing timestamps.

session_resume.description: Runs when resuming work after a crash or interrupt. Verifies invariants.

pre_release.description: Full audit before release or deploy. Dry-run only — reports issues without fixing.

new_file_detected.description: Runs when new .md files are detected at root level or in unclassified locations. Classifies and suggests moves.

docs_internal_reorganize.description: Runs when flat files inside docs/ should be reclassified into subdirectories.

nightly_cron.description: Nightly classification pass. Catches new unclassified files.

auto_scope_rules.description: Defines which files the Organizer can automatically move without human approval.
allowed_auto_move: Root-level .md files not matching code_dir patterns
Files inside docs/ that need reclassification into docs/ subdirectories
never_auto_move: Files inside apps/, packages/, src/, lib/ (code-co-located)
Any file listed in the God file Active Documents table that has been active for < 7 days
Any file that would produce a collision resolution (same filename exists at target)
auto_scope_rules.collision_policy: If a move would produce a collision, skip the file and log COLLISION_SKIPPED. Do not auto-rename.

pipeline.description: Defines the full Manager → Organizer → Manager pipeline for manual invocation.

steps.description: Initial scan: timestamps, Purpose, God file, lifecycle state
Classify files, report planned moves. No filesystem changes.
Human reviews planned moves. Approves or rejects.
Reconcile manifest. Update paths. Rewrite links. Final report.

pre_commit_strict_mode.description: When true, the pre-commit hook blocks commits. When false, it only warns.
